e.title: Assuris（加拿大）：寿险与健康险保单持有人保障 + 保障计算器
e.title_en: Assuris (Canada): life and health insurance policyholder protection plus a protection calculator
e.title_hk: Assuris（加拿大）：壽險與健康險保單持有人保障 + 保障計算器
e.summary: 加拿大寿险与健康险保单持有人保障机构：按产品公布保障水平与上限、成员公司名单，并提供「保障计算器」让持有人查询自身保障额度
e.summary_en: Canada’s life and health insurance policyholder protection body: it publishes protection levels and limits by product and a list of member companies, and offers a "protection calculator" letting policyholders check their own coverage
e.summary_hk: 加拿大壽險與健康險保單持有人保障機構：按產品公布保障水平與上限、成員公司名單，並提供「保障計算器」讓持有人查詢自身保障額度
e.body:
**Assuris** 是**加拿大的寿险与健康险保单持有人保障机构**——**当成员保险公司倒闭时，保障保单持有人继续获得给付**。本条目与同轮的 [[nolhga]]、[[fscs-uk]] 同属**「保单持有人保障」形态**，但 Assuris 补的是该形态此前没有的东西：**一个把「我到底有多少受保障」做成可自测工具的实例**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页实测 **269.7KB，标题「Assuris」**（体量在四站中最大，说明**包含大量面向公众的说明内容**）；⭐ **「Assuris Protection Calculator（保障计算器）」页 `/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection-calculator/`，实测 171.3KB，标题「Assuris Protection Calculator | Assuris」**——**这是一个让保单持有人自测保障额度的交互工具**；⭐ **「Assuris Protection by Product（按产品的保障）」页 `/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection/`，实测 231.4KB，标题「Assuris Protection by Product」**——**按产品类型列明保障水平与上限**；⭐ **「List of Member Companies（成员公司名单）」页 `/how-am-i-protected/list-of-member-companies/`，实测 252.2KB，标题「List of Member Companies」**；导航实测另含 **`/member-companies/member-companies-resources/`**、**`/i-am-a-financial-advisor/steps-to-determine-protection/`（判断保障的步骤）**、**`/i-am-a-financial-advisor/continuing-education-accreditation/`（继续教育认证）**、**`/i-am-a-financial-advisor/financial-advisor-toolkit/`**、**`/about-us/industry-partners/`（行业伙伴）**、**`/how-am-i-protected/policyholder-resources/`**，并外链 **`financeprotection.ca`**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「保障上限的可查询化」这一做法**——[[nolhga]] 是「破产名单 + 成本」，[[fscs-uk]] 是「失败机构处理 + 征费」，而 **Assuris 把「按产品的保障上限」与「自测计算器」直接做给保单持有人用**；**对做产品设计与消费者沟通的学生，「保障上限」从监管文件变成用户可查的参数，是一个具体的产品化样本**（可与 [[vhis-standard-premium]] 的按标准计划与保费、[[mpf-fund-platform]] 的公众查询平台并读——**三者都是「把监管参数做成公众可用工具」**）。**② 「成员公司名单」是现成的市场结构资料**——**252.2KB 的名单页**可用于确认**哪些公司受保、哪些不受保**，这对**评估加拿大寿险市场集中度与保障覆盖面**是直接材料。**③ 与 [[nolhga]]、[[fscs-uk]] 并读构成三地制度对照**——**美国是州级协会分摊、英国是统一法定基金、加拿大是单一行业机构**；**同一功能，三种组织形态**，这是本轮最有价值的横向结构。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量与导航结构**，**但未使用保障计算器、未打开任何产品的保障上限数字、未查看成员公司名单内容**，因此**不能转述任何保障上限金额、产品范围或成员公司名称**；**② 「保障计算器」的输入项、算法逻辑与实际输出本次未核实**——**本词条只主张该工具存在并有独立页面，不描述其如何计算**；**③ Assuris 的法定地位、其与加拿大监管机构（OSFI）的关系、以及保障触发条件本次未核实**（**[[osfi-canada-data]] 已在池内，但两者关系本次未核实，故不作关联陈述**）；**④ 其覆盖范围是否含财产险本次未核实**——**名称中的「life and health」来自机构名称与页面结构，本词条据此表述，未另行核实**；**⑤** 本词条**不主张** Assuris 提供精算工具或市场统计数据。**核实说明**：首页（269.7KB）、`/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection-calculator/`（171.3KB）、`/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection/`（231.4KB）、`/how-am-i-protected/list-of-member-companies/`（252.2KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与导航；**未使用计算器、未打开保障上限数字或成员名单内容**。
e.body_en:
**Assuris** is **Canada’s life and health insurance policyholder protection body** — **when a member insurer fails, it protects policyholders so their benefits continue**. This entry belongs with [[nolhga]] and [[fscs-uk]] from the same round in the **"policyholder protection"** form, but adds something that form previously lacked: **a working example of turning "how much of my coverage is actually protected" into a tool people can check themselves**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage measures **269.7KB with the title "Assuris"** (the largest of the four sites, indicating **substantial public-facing explanatory content**); ⭐ the **"Assuris Protection Calculator" page `/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection-calculator/` measures 171.3KB with the title "Assuris Protection Calculator | Assuris"** — **an interactive tool letting policyholders check their own protected amount**; ⭐ the **"Assuris Protection by Product" page `/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection/` measures 231.4KB with the title "Assuris Protection by Product"** — **protection levels and limits set out by product type**; ⭐ the **"List of Member Companies" page `/how-am-i-protected/list-of-member-companies/` measures 252.2KB with the title "List of Member Companies"**; measured navigation also includes **`/member-companies/member-companies-resources/`**, **`/i-am-a-financial-advisor/steps-to-determine-protection/`**, **`/i-am-a-financial-advisor/continuing-education-accreditation/`**, **`/i-am-a-financial-advisor/financial-advisor-toolkit/`**, **`/about-us/industry-partners/`** and **`/how-am-i-protected/policyholder-resources/`**, with an outbound link to **`financeprotection.ca`**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "making protection limits queryable" practice** — [[nolhga]] offers "insolvency lists and costs" and [[fscs-uk]] "failed-firm handling and levies", whereas **Assuris builds "protection limits by product" and a self-check calculator directly for policyholders**; **for students working on product design and consumer communication, a protection limit moving from a regulatory document into a user-queryable parameter is a concrete productisation sample** (readable with [[vhis-standard-premium]] on VHIS standard plans and premiums and [[mpf-fund-platform]]’s public platform — **all three turn regulatory parameters into public-facing tools**). **② The member company list is ready-made market-structure material** — **a 252.2KB list page** usable to establish **which firms are covered and which are not**, direct material for **assessing Canadian life market concentration and protection coverage**. **③ Read with [[nolhga]] and [[fscs-uk]] it forms a three-country institutional comparison** — **US: state-level association assessments; UK: a unified statutory fund; Canada: a single industry body**; **one function, three organisational forms** — the most valuable cross-cutting structure of this round.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes and navigation structure**, **but used no protection calculator, opened no product protection limit and viewed no member company list content**, so **no limit amount, product scope or member company name can be restated**; **② the calculator’s inputs, algorithm and actual output were not verified** — **this entry claims only that the tool exists with its own page, and does not describe how it computes**; **③ Assuris’s statutory status, its relationship with the Canadian regulator (OSFI) and the trigger conditions for protection were not verified** (**[[osfi-canada-data]] is already in the corpus, but the relationship was not verified, so no linkage is asserted**); **④ whether the scope includes property and casualty insurance was not verified** — **"life and health" is taken from the organisation’s name and page structure, and is stated on that basis only**; **⑤** this entry **does not claim Assuris provides actuarial tools or market statistics**. **Verification note**: the homepage (269.7KB), `/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection-calculator/` (171.3KB), `/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection/` (231.4KB) and `/how-am-i-protected/list-of-member-companies/` (252.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no calculator was used and no limit figure or member list content was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**Assuris** 是**加拿大的壽險與健康險保單持有人保障機構**——**當成員保險公司倒閉時，保障保單持有人繼續獲得給付**。本條目與同輪的 [[nolhga]]、[[fscs-uk]] 同屬**「保單持有人保障」形態**，但補上該形態此前沒有的東西：**一個把「我到底有多少受保障」做成可自測工具的實例**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁實測 **269.7KB，標題「Assuris」**（四站中體量最大）；⭐ **「Assuris Protection Calculator」頁實測 171.3KB**——**讓保單持有人自測保障額度的交互工具**；⭐ **「Assuris Protection by Product」頁實測 231.4KB**——**按產品類型列明保障水平與上限**；⭐ **「List of Member Companies」頁實測 252.2KB**；導航另含 **member-companies-resources**、**steps-to-determine-protection（判斷保障的步驟）**、**continuing-education-accreditation（繼續教育認證）**、**financial-advisor-toolkit**、**about-us/industry-partners**、**policyholder-resources**，並外鏈 **`financeprotection.ca`**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「保障上限的可查詢化」這一做法**——[[nolhga]] 是「破產名單 + 成本」、[[fscs-uk]] 是「失敗機構處理 + 徵費」，而 **Assuris 把「按產品的保障上限」與「自測計算器」直接做給保單持有人用**；**保障上限從監管文件變成用戶可查的參數**（可與 [[vhis-standard-premium]]、[[mpf-fund-platform]] 並讀——**三者都是「把監管參數做成公眾可用工具」**）。**② 「成員公司名單」（252.2KB）是現成的市場結構資料**。**③ 與 [[nolhga]]、[[fscs-uk]] 並讀構成三地制度對照**——**美國州級協會分攤、英國統一法定基金、加拿大單一行業機構**；**同一功能，三種組織形態**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量與導航結構**，**但未使用保障計算器、未打開任何產品的保障上限數字、未查看成員公司名單內容**，故**不能轉述任何保障上限金額、產品範圍或成員公司名稱**；**② 計算器的輸入項、算法邏輯與實際輸出未核實**——**本詞條只主張該工具存在並有獨立頁面，不描述其如何計算**；**③ 其法定地位、與加拿大監管機構（OSFI）的關係、保障觸發條件未核實**（**[[osfi-canada-data]] 已在池內，但兩者關係未核實，故不作關聯陳述**）；**④ 覆蓋範圍是否含財產險未核實**——**「壽險與健康險」來自機構名稱與頁面結構，本詞條據此表述**；**⑤** 本詞條**不主張** Assuris 提供精算工具或市場統計數據**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並讀取標題與導航；**未使用計算器、未打開保障上限數字或成員名單內容**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（首页 269.7KB 标题「Assuris」；⭐/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection-calculator/ 171.3KB 标题「Assuris Protection Calculator | Assuris」；⭐/how-am-i-protected/assuris-protection/ 231.4KB 标题「Assuris Protection by Product」；⭐/how-am-i-protected/list-of-member-companies/ 252.2KB 标题「List of Member Companies」；导航实测含 member-companies-resources、steps-to-determine-protection、continuing-education-accreditation、financial-advisor-toolkit、about-us/industry-partners、policyholder-resources，外链 financeprotection.ca）+ ★与同轮 nolhga/fscs-uk 构成「美/英/加」三种保障组织形态对照；未使用保障计算器、未打开保障上限数字或成员名单内容、未核实其与 OSFI 的关系与保障触发条件
